primary: sum of all logical prompt+completion tokens on all 600 assigned paired tasks per model, including failed and timed-out trials
practically_useful_effect: at least 15 percent fewer assigned total tokens for selective versus rich
quality_guardrail: correct and accepted completion; upper one-sided bound for rich-minus-selective loss below 0.05 per model
decision: Report every model separately. A confirmatory pass requires zero integrity failures, cost-saving lower bounds above 0.15 and quality-loss upper bounds below 0.05 in both task-stratified and source-cluster bootstraps. No post-outcome method, binary, router, or task-set repair.
multiplicity: Bonferroni four-model familywise alpha 0.05; one-sided alpha 0.0125 per model for both cost and quality gates; also show unadjusted descriptive intervals
independent_unit: QA task identity; 200 per source family, one paired contrast per model; cluster MMLU by subject and SQuAD by article for sensitivity
missingness: All assigned tasks retained. Timeout or unaccepted answer is a quality failure and its paid tokens count. Provider/integrity failure is explicitly missing, never silently replaced; pause a model if technical failures exceed max(3, 5 percent of completed trials)
clean_holdout: 600 identities selected before any v2 model outcome; all IDs excluded from prior f10 clean and registered qa-terminal development ledger
